strings.choisis ton dessin et fais renaître ses: Choose a picture and bring its colours back. You can continue painting whenever you like.
strings.glisse un doigt pour colorier · deux doi: Drag one finger to paint · Use two fingers to move and zoom
strings.clic maintenu : colorier · deux doigts s: Hold click: paint · Two fingers on trackpad: move · Pinch or Ctrl + wheel: zoom · Right click: move
strings.un lapin par ligne et colonne: One rabbit per row and column
strings.choisis ton premier lapin et donne-lui u: Choose your first rabbit and give it a name.
strings.découvre les pièces avec les boutons du: Explore the rooms using the buttons below.
strings.touche le livre pour retrouver ces conse: Tap the book to read these tips anytime.
strings.renouvelés à minuit, selon l’heure de to: Refresh at midnight according to your device clock. Earned rewards remain available to claim.
strings.réussir un memory, puzzle ou lapidoku, o: Complete a Memory game, puzzle or Lapidoku, or travel 20 m in the Garden
strings.terminer un parcours d’agilité d’au moin: Finish an agility course of at least 20 m
strings.terminer un quiz, quel que soit le score: Finish a quiz with any score
strings.chaque quiz terminé compte, quel que soi: Every finished quiz counts, whatever the score
strings.récupère ta récompense pour révéler le p: Claim your reward to reveal the next milestone. Available activities have their own goals. Claimed rewards are yours to keep.
strings.tu peux choisir trois favoris. retire un: You can choose three favourites. Remove a star to choose another.
Your drawers are empty for now.
strings.ajoute des articles pour les lapins de t: Add items for the rabbits you choose.
strings.je garde tes articles. que veux-tu ajout: I’ll keep your items here. What would you like to add?
strings.je rassemble tes articles sur le comptoi: I’m gathering your items on the counter.
strings.tes articles sont prêts. vérifie ton pan: Your items are ready. Check your basket before paying.
strings.tiens, prends ça, ça te fera du bien !: Here you go, this will help you feel better!
I join neighbouring pieces that are correctly placed.
strings.j’arrive près de ces pièces !: I’m coming over to those pieces!
strings.la couturière relie les pièces bien plac: The seamstress is joining the correctly placed pieces!
strings.choisir cette recette pour la cuisiner: Choose this recipe to cook it
strings.barre pleine : aliment conserve dans la: Food bar full: food stays in your supplies
strings.je range ton plat sur son etagere?: I’m putting your dish on its shelf…
strings.ton plat est range !: Your dish is on the shelf!
Some ingredients for this dish are missing.
strings.je peux cuisiner ce plat. appuie sur pré: I can cook this dish. Press Prepare this dish.
strings.la barre de nourriture est pleine. garde: The food bar is full. Keep this food for later.
strings.tous les ingredients sont recuperes, je: All ingredients collected, I’m going back to cook.
strings.je connais les sentiers ! choisis un com: I know the trails! Choose a companion and a destination.
strings.coucou ! prêt pour une escapade ?: Hello! Ready for a little adventure?
strings.voyons quel sentier emprunter…: Let’s see which trail to take…
Look! There are treasures around here.
strings.le sac est prêt. à toi de choisir ton co: The bag is packed. Choose your companion!
strings.1 h d’exploration = 1 h dans la vraie vi: 1 hour of exploration = 1 real hour. You can close the game: the journey continues.
strings.le niveau et l’affinité du lapin amélior: Your rabbit’s level and affinity improve the odds. Found eggs join the burrow’s usual eggs.
strings.ce compagnon est déjà en voyage ou atten: This companion is already travelling or waiting for you to collect their finds.
strings.son affinité augmente les chances de tro: Their affinity improves the chance of rare finds, but the required level is still needed.
strings.dans son élément : bonus de trouvailles: In their element: bonus chance of rare finds!
Choose a rabbit and their skill.
strings.les aliments sont conservés dans la rése: Food is kept in the kitchen supplies.
strings.les soins se conservent dans ton inventa: Remedies are kept in your inventory.
strings.les dernières versions débloquées par l’: Upgrade the latest versions unlocked through friendship here, for the active rabbit.
strings.remplit toute la barre de sommeil/énergi: Completely refills the active rabbit’s sleep/energy bar when used.
strings.remplit toute la barre de propreté du la: Completely refills the active rabbit’s cleanliness bar when used.
strings.remplit toute la barre de nourriture du: Completely refills the active rabbit’s food bar when used.
strings.le prochain sommeil récupère 50 % d’éner: The next sleep restores 50% more energy. The bonus remains available if the rabbit is already rested.
strings.réduit de 25 % le coût en énergie du pro: Reduces the energy cost of the next Garden training course by 25%.
strings.augmente de 50 % l’amitié (expérience) g: Increases friendship (experience) earned on the next Garden training course by 50%.
strings.réduit de 20 % le coût en énergie des tr: Reduces the energy cost of the next three Garden training sessions by 20%. Reductions do not stack.
strings.réduit de moitié le coût en énergie d’un: Halves the energy cost of one Garden training session. Does not stack with the stamina elixir.
Restores 15 cleanliness points at a low price.
strings.au prochain brossage : +15 points de pro: Next brushing: +15 extra cleanliness and +3 extra friendship. The Brush button remains available with the upgraded shower.
strings.la prochaine interaction réussie (nourri: The next successful interaction (feeding, sleeping or cleaning) grants 5 extra friendship points.
strings.fait gagner un niveau au lapin actif, ju: Raises the active rabbit by one level, up to level 100. Rare and expensive; keeps the normal level rewards.
strings.retire les améliorations de la compétenc: Removes upgrades from the chosen skill. Its fragments become available again to upgrade another unlocked skill of the same rabbit.
strings.rend 20 points de nourriture. à conserve: Restores 20 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.rend 35 points de nourriture. à conserve: Restores 35 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.rend 20 points de nourriture. friandise: Restores 20 food points. A fruity treat to use in moderation.
strings.rend 30 points de nourriture. friandise: Restores 30 food points. A fruity treat to use in moderation.
strings.rend 25 points de nourriture. concombre: Restores 25 food points. Fresh cucumber to serve in small amounts.
strings.rend 40 points de nourriture. à utiliser: Restores 40 food points. Use from the fridge on the active rabbit.
strings.rend 25 points de nourriture. feuilles d: Restores 25 food points. Fresh, washed romaine leaves.
strings.rend 28 points de nourriture. persil, co: Restores 28 food points. Parsley, coriander and other suitable herbs.
strings.rend 30 points de nourriture. aliment de: Restores 30 food points. Rabbits’ staple food, available freely in real life.
strings.rend 18 points de nourriture. fleurs de: Restores 18 food points. Untreated chamomile flowers, offered in small amounts.
strings.rend 20 points de nourriture. pétales de: Restores 20 food points. Untreated cornflower petals, offered alongside hay.
strings.rend 20 points de nourriture. fleurs de: Restores 20 food points. Untreated calendula flowers, in small amounts.
strings.rend 22 points de nourriture. fleurs et: Restores 22 food points. Untreated dandelion flowers and leaves, introduced gradually.
strings.rend 16 points de nourriture. pétales de: Restores 16 food points. Untreated rose petals, in small amounts.
strings.bouquet de menthe fraîche et parfumée. r: A fragrant bunch of fresh mint. Restores 20 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.bouquet d'aneth aux feuilles fines et pa: A bunch of dill with fine, fragrant leaves. Restores 22 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.bouquet de coriandre fraîche. rend 22 po: A bunch of fresh coriander. Restores 22 food points. Keep in your supplies.
Crunchy celery stalks and leaves. Restores 32 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.fenouil frais aux tiges et feuilles parf: Fresh fennel with fragrant stalks and leaves. Restores 35 food points. Keep in your supplies.
strings.petites myrtilles juteuses et sucrées. r: Small, juicy, sweet blueberries. Restores 40 food points. Keep in your supplies.
